Validated by tests/read_contract_boundaries_validation.mjs; regenerate operation lists and call sites with its --print-seed flag and review the diff.

exceptions.title: Shared RuntimeInstances lazy initialization writes schema before ordinary dispatch
exceptions.effect_type: SQL DDL/ALTER and index drop/recreate in initializeStorage(), run once per instance at the start of the ordinary fetch path and of alarm on both named objects (runtime-instances, console-kv-directory-v1), before fetch selects an operation; construction runs no SQL and the account-identity inventory path is dispatched before initialization
exceptions.work_item: Adoption step 3: wire-only constructor, observation dispatch before initialization, explicit command initialization; alarm and command initialization preserved
exceptions.acceptance_test: Real Worker/DO suite with read-only trap installed before construction: cold, old, partial and current schemas; every operation listed here accounted for; write and alarm initialization still covered
exceptions.expiry_basis: Owner-approved pre-2026-12-14 disposition: the N1 interim deadline is consolidated to 2027-01-13 (within ADR 0002's 60-day window from 2026-11-14) with full B0 because routing the 5 N1 paths before initializeStorage() changes the reviewed RuntimeInstances preamble contract and requires read-only missing-table handling across all N1 backing tables.

Admin config GET: adminConfigResponse -> buildAdminState -> loadRiskProfileBindings requests risk_profile_read

exceptions.expiry_basis: Owner-approved bounded 60-day re-date from 2026-12-14 to 2027-01-13 (within ADR 0002's 60-day window from 2026-11-14): retiring B1 requires introducing an explicit versioned risk-authority import command with no-write preflight, changing absent-authority GET semantics across 8 operations protected by tests/account_settings_worker_validation.mjs, and re-anchoring the member-method witness suite built on ensureRiskProfileAuthority.

exceptions.expiry_basis: Owner-approved bounded 60-day re-date from 2026-12-14 to 2027-01-13 (within ADR 0002's 60-day window from 2026-11-14): IBKR display and typed-confirmation isolation landed in PR #1172 and is verified by tests/account_config_label_validation.mjs; the remaining three sites govern non-IBKR fallback labels (pinned by tests/account_config_label_validation.mjs) and account-options schema defaults relied on by existing stored payloads and backend target_name lookups, deferred to align with the 2027-01-13 R3/I2 checkpoint.
